codeSnippets.output: A badge pinned to the top-right corner of its card.
The sidebar scrolls normally, then sticks 16px from the top of the viewport.

exercise.instruction: Anchor the .badge to the top-right corner of its .box. Make .box position: relative, then give .badge position: absolute with top: 0 and right: 0. Finally give .badge a z-index of 10 so it always sits above overlapping content.
exercise.starterCode:
NEW

Notice how the badge corners exactly with .box — not the page.
hints: Hint 1: .box needs position: relative so it becomes the anchor.
Hint 2: .badge { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; z-index: 10; }
Hint 3: Without the anchor, the badge would snap to the top-right of the page.

quiz.question: An absolutely positioned element anchors to...
options: the page root if no positioned ancestor exists

quiz.question: Which position value pins an element to the viewport so it never scrolls?
